title: Participation in projects

blocks.heading: Participation in projects
blocks.text: Rural and urban projects can connect women’s organisations, self-help groups and agencies to skills, finance or service needs. Assess retained benefits, meaningful decisions and the inclusion of less-represented participants. A project called a women’s scheme does not establish impact.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: A practical access test
blocks.text: A fictional enterprise course can offer an accessible local venue for fewer people or a large central session with no travel assistance. The central session reaches more places on paper, while the local venue may be usable by residents who cannot afford the journey. Compare completion, quality and access for the intended group; a lower attendance total does not by itself establish a weaker inclusive result.
